name: Network Connection Initiated To AzureWebsites.NET By Non-Browser Process
description: Detects an initiated network connection by a non browser process on the system to "azurewebsites.net". The latter was often used by threat actors as a malware hosting and exfiltration site.
author: GAI_CTI
query: (network.direction:true AND destination.domain:*azurewebsites.net) AND (NOT ((process.executable:(C\:\\Program\ Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe OR C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe)) OR (process.executable:C\:\\Users\\* AND process.executable:*\\AppData\\Local\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe) OR (process.executable:(C\:\\Program\ Files\\Mozilla\ Firefox\\firefox.exe OR C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Mozilla\ Firefox\\firefox.exe)) OR (process.executable:C\:\\Users\\* AND process.executable:*\\AppData\\Local\\Mozilla\ Firefox\\firefox.exe) OR (process.executable:(C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Internet\ Explorer\\iexplore.exe OR C\:\\Program\ Files\\Internet\ Explorer\\iexplore.exe)) OR (process.executable:C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Microsoft\\EdgeWebView\\Application\\* OR process.executable:*\\WindowsApps\\MicrosoftEdge.exe OR (process.executable:(C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge.exe OR C\:\\Program\ Files\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge.exe))) OR ((process.executable:(C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Microsoft\\EdgeCore\\* OR C\:\\Program\ Files\\Microsoft\\EdgeCore\\*)) AND (process.executable:(*\\msedge.exe OR *\\msedgewebview2.exe))) OR ((process.executable:(*C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Safari\\* OR *C\:\\Program\ Files\\Safari\\*)) AND process.executable:*\\safari.exe) OR ((process.executable:(*C\:\\Program\ Files\\Windows\ Defender\ Advanced\ Threat\ Protection\\* OR *C\:\\Program\ Files\\Windows\ Defender\\* OR *C\:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows\ Defender\\Platform\\*)) AND (process.executable:(*\\MsMpEng.exe OR *\\MsSense.exe))) OR
